description: Change a task's name, dates, or whether it is archived. Only the fields you pass change. Moving the dates also moves every task that depends on this one, and the reply lists everything that moved — tell the user about those too. Archiving hides a task from every view and is reversible; there is deliberately no way to delete a task through this server, because that would detach the time already logged against it. Requires the tasks:write scope; renaming an end-to-end-encrypted project's task also needs PYUNTO_TM_PASSWORD.

archived.description: true hides it from every view (reversible), false brings it back.

name: update_task
